report_name: Banbury Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan (LCWIP)
how_pct_was_used: The PCT was used to estimate cycling potential, identify existing and future cycling demand, and inform the prioritisation of the cycle network by highlighting routes with the largest numbers of potential cyclists.
specific_evidence_of_impact: Public consultation feedback led to significant alterations to the final document, including updates to the clarity of proposals and changes to route maps. Additionally, new cycling infrastructure and facilities have been secured from development sites, including improvements to the tunnel under the M40, an off-carriageway cycle path along Old Daventry Road, off-road cycle lanes at the northern end of Warwick Road, and contributions towards upgrading the canal towpath.
